text_block_list.text:
On our way back after spending time out 
with Symboli Rudolf, as it was getting a 
bit late—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. There's somewhere I'd like to 
stop by before heading back...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you don't mind, would you come with me?
choice_data_list: Sure, but where are we going?
Sure, but where are you going?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing. It just looked like 
there would be a beautiful crescent moon 
tonight—

The place Symboli Rudolf brought me to was 
a shrine atop a hill.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There are few obstructions and lights 
here, so you can see the moon very 
clearly.

Sure enough, looking up, a beautiful 
crescent moon hung brightly in the night 
sky.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...I have not brought this up very often 
before, but..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, people used to call me 
"Luna" because of the color and shape of 
my hair.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Does that sound surprising? Well, it's 
something like a childhood name.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I loved being called by that 
name... After hearing its origin, every 
time I looked at the moon, it brought me 
joy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I resolved to walk the Imperial 
Path, no one has called me by that name 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...It's not as though I feel lonely about 
it or anything.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet, for some reason―― I just felt like 
sharing it with you.
choice_data_list: That's a cute name, isn't it?

I'll remember this forever, even from now 
on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet, for some reason―― I just felt like 
sharing it with you.
choice_data_list: That's a cute name, isn't it?

I'll remember this forever, even from now 
on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm glad you took the time to listen, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. I wonder what it could be.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I feel a strange sense of relief— as clear 
and refreshing as this night sky.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Let's head back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
From tomorrow on as well... I'm counting 
on you to stay by my side.

Holding close the memories she had shared 
with me, I vowed in my heart to stay by 
her side from tomorrow on as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Just because it's cute doesn't mean 
you should call me that in public.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When around other people, call you— Heh, I 
see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Luna-tical as it sounds, please call me 
Luna...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this is wonderful. In the sense that 
only you could ever understand it, too.

I walked back to the academy under the 
moonlight with her, as she tried her best 
to hold back her giggles.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ......What a relief.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Even after I reach the end of this road 
one day and embody my ideals—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You remember who I was before reaching 
that point.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that will... become my pillar of 
support.

Beneath the moonlight, Symboli Rudolf 
smiles.

I firmly vowed in my heart to continue 
walking alongside her.
